name: botui
description: BotUI — open-source, copy-and-own UI components for agent products

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" build && node scripts/emit-css.mjs && node scripts/build-registry.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm registry:check
